subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should Feishu multi-bot mention recognition proceed with a proven union_id source, switch to cross-app open_id alias mapping, or wait for broader Feishu multi-bot identity work?
rationale: The bug is real, but the selected identity contract directly controls whether Feishu group messages are delivered, suppressed, or misrouted, and the submitted union_id source is contradicted by issue evidence.

options.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework the Feishu identity fix on current main only after proving the stable field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering every mention admission path.

options.title: Supersede With Replacement
options.body: Use this branch as investigation context and move the canonical fix to a narrower replacement that maps known cross-app identifiers without relying on unavailable bot union_id data.

options.title: Close The UnionId Branch
options.body: If maintainers confirm bot union_id is unavailable for this workflow, close this stale PR while keeping the canonical issue open for a different strategy.

recommendation.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework the Feishu identity fix on current main only after proving the stable field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering every mention admission path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, requested changes on the PR, and have the strongest current Feishu identity-path review signal.
